note: What a good story → template run should do. Never show this file to an agent under test.

muttrah-voice-note.txt.shape: quiet, a repeated daily encounter, no stated conflict: kishotenketsu or short-one-moment fit; a three-act/hero's journey choice should be justified
gaps: the turn (the writer says «ما أعرف شو يصير بعدين»)
who the boy is / why he asks the time
must: quote «ما أعرف شو يصير بعدين» or treat the middle/turn as a gap, not fill it
keep the voice-note fillers in the story text as sent
no invented event (e.g. the boy steals a watch, the shop closes, the man dies)
ending wish «حزينة شوي وجميلة» kept as tone/ending, with a question

rider-idea.txt.shape: one night, one turn (the order from his old neighbourhood): short-one-moment fits
gaps: what happens at the old neighbourhood (the turn's outcome)
must: the order from the old neighbourhood placed at or before the turn as a question
no invented answer to who ordered
